consequence.statement: Bug fix: anonymous usage data is no longer sent cumulatively; the evidence states no operational consequence for operators.

original.statement: Traefik 3.0.0 fixes anonymous usage logging so that usage data is no longer sent cumulatively.

decision.reason: [ev-1a93967aa9fb] is a single changelog line under "Bug fixes", tagged [logs]. It says the anonymous usage log is no longer sent cumulatively. It does not say that anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or must be migrated, so no action-eligible kind is supported. A logging fix with no stated operator impact fits "none" (informational). The line is short and does not make clear whether it is the log message or the usage data that is no longer sent cumulatively, so confidence is low.
